description: Where are you starting? (F225, F228; framework .planning/research/bmuz-vision/entry-research.md and stages.md): one question about the game (a second only when something already exists), the engine reads what was shared onto DISCOVER.md's shelves and works out the gap map and where to start — Ideate, Define or later, any step — shows that proposal in a turn of its own and the creative confirms, then moves into that stage. The labels describe the game, never the person.

steps.description: Where's your game right now? (and, when something exists, what you want from this pass)
Intake: what you shared onto DISCOVER.md's shelves (your own words marked), what it covers stage by stage, and where to start
Where I'd start you: what I read, what it already covers, and the stage to start in
